description: Your Desktop has 18 files belonging to three personal projects, identified by their filename prefix: HV_ files belong to Home Renovation, SC_ files belong to School Schedule, and GD_ files belong to Garden Design. Create ~/Documents/Projects/ with one subfolder per project. Move each file to its matching subfolder. Lock every moved file using Finder (Get Info → Locked checkbox). Inside each project subfolder, create a README.txt file that lists all the filenames it contains, one per line. When done, your Desktop should have none of the HV_, SC_, or GD_ files remaining.
